triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The red-target-bindings.json v1 store persists exactly one binding per acceptanceTargetRef, records targetBindingDigest = canonDigest over the createdAt-STRIPPED 3-field subobject (not the stored entry), and its committed-tree reader resolves a binding from a git ref rather than the live directory.

expectedRedTargets is exported as a shared resolver with an identical computed set, and red_evidence_binding_set is rejected for an out-of-expectedRedTargets acceptanceTargetRef and while a FOREIGN session holds an active owner lease.

red-target-bindings.json is registered as lifecycle metadata and red_evidence_binding_set is registered at all 13 wiring points (incl. the closed AgentDispatchMutationCommand union and permittedMutations) and the four ProofStory enumerations + frozen catalog order, so the three existing contracts pass.
red-evidence-target-binding-smoke is registered in validate.commands and passes, and no existing gate verdict (redEvidenceSatisfied/missingRedEvidence) changes.
